# Erdos.p394 — Erdős problem 394

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/394
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/394.lean`, theorem `erdos_394.variants.hall_conjecture`, AMS 11).

Erdős and Hall conjecture that the sum is $o(x^2/(\log x)^c)$ for any $c<\log 2$.

## Statement
∀ c < Real.log 2, (fun x ↦ ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊,
    (t 2 n : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
    (fun x ↦ x ^ 2 / (Real.log x) ^ c)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
